scope: Cross-class survey of the 10 other LTC/LGTC-derived classes' (GroupBase, ItemBase, WidgetHandle, Math, Global, CommandBase, JudgeBase, QuestBase, String, Table) secondary vftable slot 0+1+5 to test the hypothesis that each class has its own _onFinalize fire method. Hypothesis FALSIFIED. KEY FINDING: FUN_006F6900 is LITERALLY SHARED across all 11 classes' slot 5 - one engine-wide implementation, not per-class overrides. Slots 0 and 1 ARE per-class (uniform 27-byte / 94-byte templates with class-specific subobject-dtor/ctor targets).

method.step1: FindSymbolByName 'Application::Lua::Script::Client::Control::' substring with limit=5000 to enumerate all symbols in the namespace. Filter for '::vftable' suffix per the 11 target classes.
method.step2: Extract per-class primary + secondary (+tertiary for Global) vftable VAs from the symbol output. Layout pattern: meta_ptr + slots + next_meta_ptr + next_slots.
method.step3: DumpMemRange 10 secondary (or tertiary for Global) vftable ranges 0x40 bytes each to read slot 0..15 contents for each class. Plus 10 primary ranges to verify primary slot count.
method.step4: Bulk DumpFunctionDecomp of slot 0 + slot 1 functions for all 10 classes (20 decomps total) to verify the uniform-template hypothesis.
method.step5: Catalog 10 vector-deleting-dtor entries + 9 clone-factory entries (QuestBase factory pre-existing as BCS-Y-0898 - amend not create). 4 amendments to BCS-Y-0898/1529/1530/1531.

key_findings: **SLOT 5 IS LITERALLY SHARED**: All 11 LTC/LGTC-derived classes' secondary vftable slot 5 = FUN_006F6900 (same address). This is ONE engine-wide _onFinalize fire implementation, NOT 11 per-class overrides. the hypothesis that 'each class likely has its own slot 5 _onFinalize fire method' is FALSIFIED.

**SLOT 0 IS CLASS-SPECIFIC (uniform template)**: All 11 classes have their own 27-byte vector deleting dtor at slot 0 of secondary vftable. Pattern: `fn(this, flag) { class_subobj_dtor(this); if (flag&1) _free(this); return this; }`. Only the subobject dtor target varies per-class.

**SLOT 1 IS CLASS-SPECIFIC (uniform template)**: All 11 classes have their own 94-byte clone/factory at slot 1 of secondary vftable. Pattern: `fn() { mem = operator_new(SIZE, COOKIE); if (mem==0) return 0; return class_ctor(mem); }`. Allocation size (0x64-0x78) and ctor target vary per-class.

**LTC vs LGTC PRIMARY VFTABLE ASYMMETRY**: LTC-derived classes (GroupBase, ItemBase, WidgetHandle) have 7-slot primary vftables (dtor + 6 LuaControl polymorphic methods). LGTC-derived classes have 1-4 slot primary vftables (StatusBase/Math/CommandBase: 1 slot; JudgeBase/QuestBase/String/Table: 2 slots; Global: 4 slots + tertiary). Variation reflects different inheritance chain depths.

**GLOBAL HAS A TERTIARY VFTABLE**: Global is the only class with 3 vftables (primary 0x00fd6090, secondary 0x00fd60a4 1-slot, tertiary 0x00fd60ac LGTC chain). Tertiary occupies the LGTC role - slot 5 there is FUN_006F6900 as expected. Layout: 4-slot primary + 1-slot secondary + ~25-slot tertiary.
